currentParagraphText: “You have a book full of Forbidden Knowledge within your Soulspace?” Artemis asked.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “You have a book full of Forbidden Knowledge within your Soulspace?” Artemis asked.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Yep. With knowledge not even the Viper knows about,” Jake said with a cheeky smile.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “No, I literally can’t tell you,” Jake did something Villy had done several times to him before as he smirked. “It’s related to Forbidden Knowledge. The book I’m reading is Forbidden Knowledge made material.”
